shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials, ability AI, hiding of undiscovered traits, diets and market value.

## Status
- Phase 1, visuals, materials, light, settings (tabs), ability AI, lead-in discovery, hiding undiscovered traits, Biotech human birth inheritance: all tested (last summary commit 5fe4263).
- **Phase 3 step 4, diet traits (builds 46–50) and trait market value (builds 51–52): reviewed, not yet tested.**
- Phase 3 remaining: optional VRE gene compat.

## Startup
Settings load in the Mod constructor. Harmony PatchAll runs in `[StaticConstructorOnStartup] TitanPatcher` after defs load (patching PregnancyUtility from the Mod ctor broke pawn generation, run #48; lore saved). TitanMaterialStartup appends StatPart_TitanTraits then StatPart_TitanMaterial to MarketValue.

## Market value (Source/TitanValue.cs)
- Base value = creature's MarketValue before the framework's parts (vanilla, age and health included). Traits part runs before the material part so material never inflates trait prices.
- Per trait: `marketValuePercent` / `marketValueOffset` on the def if set (either replaces the default); otherwise pointCost × (base × `valuePercentPerPoint` 0.2 + `valueFlatPerPoint` 100). Negative-cost traits lower value; total never below 10% of base.
- Context: trade (TradeSession active AND Dialog_Trade open; TradeSession.trader is never cleared) = discovered traits + mystery bonus (base × `mysteryTradeBonus` 0.25, once, if any trait is undiscovered; both buying and selling). Info card (TitanHiding active) = discovered only. Everything else (colony wealth → raid points) = all traits, no mystery bonus.
- MarketValue is not a cached stat, so modes never leak into each other.
- Public API for content mods: TitanValueUtility.TraitPoints(pawn, includeHidden), BaseValue(pawn), TraitsValue(pawn, includeHidden).

## Diet (Source/TitanDiet.cs, TitanTraitDef.diet)
- XML `diet`: addFoodTypes, removeFoodTypes (FoodTypeFlags, comma list), refuseFoods (ThingDefs), extraFoods (thing + nutrition per unit for non-food), hunts (bool?).
- Hediff_Titan.Diet merges every trait's diet plus the creature's own material (non-food, nutrition = setting `materialNutritionPerUnit`, default 0.05, 0 = off). Rebuilt with the stage. Null when nothing changes the diet.
- FoodUtility.FoodIsSuitable postfix: added types / ingestible extraFoods become edible; refused foods never eaten. No allowed food means starving.
- PawnUtility.IsPotentiallyPredator postfix: `hunts`. Removing Corpse on any trait always stops hunting (vanilla's hunt job eats the kill without a diet check). ConfigError when one trait sets both.
- FoodUtility.BestFoodSourceOnMap postfix: plant search for titans whose diet adds plants (vanilla region limit, rope check).
- JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob postfix: hungry and nothing found → nearest diet non-food → TF_EatNonFood job (walk, chew 300–1500 ticks, consume units, add nutrition). Forbidden respected for colony animals; wild ones eat anything. Region limit from private GetMaxRegionsToScan via delegate with fallback.
- Known gaps: JobGiver_EatRandom and right-click ingest use the race diet; diet-added foods override willNeverEat and mutant food types.

## Inheritance (Source/Patches.cs)
BirthContext records parents in DoBirthSpawn, CompHatcher.Hatch, PregnancyUtility.ApplyBirthOutcome. TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix applies before spawn; ApplyBirthOutcome postfix covers doctor-carry. Material from a parent (coin flip if both), traits by 1-(1-chance×setting)^carriers, discovered if a parent knew it.

## Ability AI (Source/TitanAI.cs)
Postfix on DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob runs JobGiver_TitanAbilities every 30 ticks when the constant tree gave nothing: trait aiThinkTrees, then offensive trait abilities at the current enemy, then self-targeted ones. Not for player colonists. Setting `abilityAI`.

## Discovery of ability traits
Notify_PawnUsedVerb on resolve; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix+postfix wraps this cast's preCastActions so the reveal happens when the visible lead-in starts.

## Hiding undiscovered traits (Source/TitanHiding.cs)
During DrawStatsReport for a titan with hidden traits: discovered-only stage, null stage for hediffs only hidden traits grant, capacities dirtied and stat caches cleared before and after. Ability.GizmosVisible postfix hides abilities only hidden traits grant.

## Mod settings (TitanSettings)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits (inherit, messages, ability AI, value % per point, value silver per point, mystery trade bonus) / Materials (armor, damage, fire, butcher, precious, market value, nutrition per unit).

## Harmony patches (25)
BestKindLabel; ApplyBirthOutcome ×3; DoBirthSpawn ×2; CompHatcher.Hatch ×2; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear; MakeCorpse; Corpse.IngestibleNow; Pawn.ButcherProducts; DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting ×2; DrawStatsReport ×2; Hediff.CurStage; Ability.GizmosVisible; FoodIsSuitable; IsPotentiallyPredator; BestFoodSourceOnMap; JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Rockgut, Bloodthirsty, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech).
